spec_match.rationale: The physical-vs-logical corner mapping is demonstrated with the real border-start-start-radius longhand (the mapping the corner-start-start shorthand inherits), and the displayed shorthand names match CSS Borders 4.

interactive.rationale: writing-mode and direction selects re-style both live cards and rebuild a which-physical-corner report table read from computed style.

blurb_alignment.rationale: The index promises 'flip the writing mode and watch which set follows the text', which is exactly the two-panel comparison delivered.

edge_cases.rationale: Covers all three writing modes crossed with ltr/rtl, the identical-corner case in horizontal-tb/ltr (explicitly narrated), and a labelled degraded path when neither shorthands nor logical radii exist.

references.rationale: Links https://chromestatus.com/feature/5152215540039680, CSS Borders 4 and MDN logical properties.

conformance.rationale: The suite's logical-corner-radius-follows-writing-mode assertion — the only one that passes on Chromium 141 — proves precisely the remapping this page visualises.

runtime_evidence.rationale: Chromium 141 headless (cloud, no chrome-devtools-mcp) via CDP: switching to vertical-rl moved the logical 30px radius to top-right and vertical-rl+rtl moved it to bottom-right while the physical card stayed top-left, with the report table confirming from computed style; corner-shape: scoop applied natively; console clean, no exceptions; screenshots both viewports.

telemetry_health.rationale: Each render logs and emits showcaseTelemetry.assert('logical-mapped', …) with writing mode, direction and the resolved corner.

design_system.rationale: Token colours, moved/fixed cells use accent colours plus text distinction, 44px selects, no static card.

accessibility.rationale: Native labelled selects, captioned report table with scopes where the moved corner is conveyed by value not colour alone, and an aria-live narration of every state change.

mobile_desktop_parity.rationale: 0px horizontal overflow at 360x740 DPR3 and 1280x800 over CDP; panels stack on mobile and the five-column table fits without clipping in the screenshot.

openQuestions.title: Also exercise corner-end-end / the other three logical corners
openQuestions.detail: Only the start-start corner is demonstrated. A small extension letting the user pick which logical corner carries the rule (start-start / start-end / end-start / end-end) would complete the mapping table and make the four-way symmetry visible; the report table already generalises. Low urgency since the mechanism is identical.

summary: Best-behaved page in this feature: on Chromium 141 headless (cloud, no chrome-devtools-mcp) the shorthands are honestly reported unsupported while the demo still proves the real remapping through border-start-start-radius plus native corner-shape scoop — verified over CDP at http://localhost:3000/v155/css-corner-shorthand-properties/logical-corners/ across vertical-rl and rtl with the computed-style report agreeing, console clean, both device classes overflow-free. The feature /conformance/ route ran 1 pass / 7 fail, the sole pass being the writing-mode remap assertion this page demonstrates.
